template.instructions: Fill the Customers sheet (optional) and the Transactions sheet. Transaction type must be CASH_IN or CASH_OUT (Cash In / Cash Out are also accepted). Currency must be an active code such as AFN, USD, or EUR. Amounts must be positive. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. At least one of customer_number or customer_name is required on each transaction row. Missing customers are created automatically. Extra columns are ignored.
